notes.content:

Yours,
Spellgarden Games & Assemble Entertainment

notes.title: Sticky Business featured in Women's Day Sale 🎉
notes.content:
Dear Sticky Business Fans,

We at Spellgarden Games are honored to be part of this year's Women’s Day Steam Sale! Discover +400 games, demos & discounts! Let’s celebrate the incredible talent of women & gender marginalized devs together 🌈🌸🥳

How?
➡️ Visit the Women’s Day Sale Page 🧙‍♀️❗
➡️ Buy or wishlist the games you like or play free Demos 🎮 
➡️ Already own Sticky Business? Show us your creative creations to celebrate the day!
➡️ Tag us with @SpellgardenDevs and show us how you celebrate Women in Games!

We want to use this chance and tell you a few words about an important topic for us.

🧙‍♀️ WOMEN 
⬇️ IN
🎮 GAMES

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43717490/80a83cb8c41db670257304380110265aa27d0bd5.jpg
We are Spellgarden Games, founded, owned and led by a majority of female devs. When we started to develop Sticky Business, we had no idea where this journey would take us. The core gameplay of Sticky Business was designed in a month. It all started with something familiar to many indie devs - a game jam! We just wanted to create a fun and simple game that stimulates creativity for everyone. A game we ourselves would also love to play. We wanted to make a game where people feel included and represented no matter the identity they have. The feedback we received till this day is mind blowing to us. We received so much love from our community and saw so many creative designs. We check our social media channels everyday and to see how much happiness these stickers spark is so beautiful. THANK YOU!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43717490/3b2a3f02fb15bfb0edd03a5480589a811ed10351.jpg

I am Kathrin Radtke, co-founder and programmer at Spellgarden Games. I fight for visibility for women and gender marginalized people in my industry. Maybe you saw me in a talk or on TikTok. I quit my job to found my own company and create my own games. This was (and still is!!) pretty scary. Sometimes you can be lucky with your game, sometimes you need help and that’s okay. WINGS created a company and a platform to highlight devs like us and what we created for you out there. So please consider checking out the event page! There are so many wonderful games that might have flown under your radar and are just waiting to be discovered! 🎉

So long story short, how can we help to shape the future of the games industry?

➡️ Create diverse, inclusive and games
➡️ Let game jams and game events be a safe space for creatives
➡️ Encourage female devs and listen to talks
➡️ Visit the Women’s Day Sale Page and support WINGS

THANK YOU ALL <3

Love,
Spellgarden Games 🔮 
Assemble Entertainment 🎮 

PS. What’s next? Well, all we can tell you is that the journey of Sticky Business is far from over 👀

Did you know we released our first DLC Plan with me?

notes.title: A Colorful Update!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

we hope you all had a strong start into September! We’ve been busy improving Sticky Business and here is everything that’s new with Update 2023.1750:

New colors!

This was one of the most popular requests! We added a bunch of new colors to choose from for your stickers:

[table equalcells=1 noborder=1]
[tr]
[td][/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43717490/45e93e4589c089e71d98a7e2ad2e16abe71022b0.png[/td][td][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

New elements!

These four sticker elements were planned in the original release, but were to shy to make an appearance for launch (and this is of course not because when we put together the sticker names for translations, a few of them slipped through).

With this update you can finally use them!

[table equalcells=1 noborder=1]
[tr]
[td][/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43717490/7999d19208d01b0488baaa1989a0e1d254545207.png[/td][td][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

We also added two other highly requested sticker items! A smaller circle for some more intricate designs and a stripe that you could use to assemble your own pride flags!

[table equalcells=1 noborder=1]
[tr]
[td][/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43717490/e07dcf348cd06997a52d1552a5f8822997a4f36c.png[/td][td][/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

Balancing

We changed how many stickers customers order in the late game, after all the special customer stories are done. So you’ll get more XP after you finished the stories and can finally unlock all those stickers!

Better sticker grabbing

We’ve changed how sticker elements get selected by the cursor. We now use the exact shape of the sticker element to determine what sticker element you want to click. It should be much easier to select the element you actually wanted to click! 

Before and after:
[table noborder=1]
[tr]
[td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43717490/5190441f2b43bb6d80ab0aa9382ede687709bd3e.gif[/td][td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43717490/0aaa09f30c98e470c167e2291b3bf6c9cfca7542.gif[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

Visual changes

We noticed that there were some areas that were a bit hard to understand. So we made the following improvements:

 made unlocked items in the shop a different color, so you see at a first glance what you haven’t bought yet
 added a counter for how many items you have bought in each category
 better explanation in Twitch messages if you can’t order more stickers
 increased the font size in a few areas


Other improvements

 fixed a bug that could cause the GOG version to crash.
 the default input method on Steam Deck is now controller
 We fixed the wrong coin balance at the end of the day.
 We added a workaround during twitch authentication if other installed programs blocked the games internet connection.


We hope you have fun with these new additions! Keep sticking! 🙂

notes.title: First Sticky Business Patch has been released! [version 2023.1695]
notes.content:
Sticky-fellas and Cozy-lovers alike!
We have just released the first patch for Sticky Business thanks to your ongoing support and overwhelming feedback. 

Without further ado, find all details below: 

Fixes
[ Fixed broken sheet overview in tutorial after restarting the game during the tutorial
 Fixed the last 4 shop upgrades not working
 “All Upgrades” achievement will not count sticker items anymore
 Fixed that deleting a sticker would make orders appear again
 Fixed Twitch chat being able to order unlisted stickers
 Moved the customes names text file to application data so players don’t get the “App wants access to documents” message
 Fixed green and yellow noms being switched and made it easier to click the noms
 Fixed "Radiant Sparkles" and "Shiny Shimmer” being switched in the upgrades and creator menus
 Fixed upgrade view with hearts and stars overlapping
 Swapped zodiac signs (leo and capricorn) and adjust costs of all zodiac signs to be the same
 Fixed numerous typos and translation issues

Additions, Improvements, and more
 We added the version number to the main menu to help with reporting bugs
 Improved: You can’t switch to a different order if you’ve placed a sticker in the box to avoid confusion
 Increased visibility of how many hearts you get from sticker level-ups
 Slightly increased the standard order count per day


Please keep the feedback coming, you know, where to find us!
Thank you for sticking with us!

notes.title: It’s Time to Open Up Shop! Sticker Making Sim Sticky Business Out Now!
notes.content:
The shop is now open!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43717490/1c739bc4b4189f8d4a8fa212b4c15f743ae43380.png

We're very excited to announce that our small business sticker-making sim, Sticky Business, is officially accepting budding new shop owners! 
Starting today, you can dive into the game and create your own beautiful stickers, organize your storefront, package orders, read customer sentiments, and more! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2303350/Sticky_Business/?utm_source=SteamNews&utm_campaign=outnow

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43717490/a388ef5eaef1092e198c5a169bf6d0f52ab588da.png

Watch the cozy new release Trailer now: 
[previewyoutube=F5K3YrEkrJw;full][/previewyoutube]

Assemble Release-Livestream today!
Assemble's Jr. Community Manager Maurice 'Skoddy' will be livestreaming Sticky Business!
Tune in on the official Assemble Twitch-channel today at 3.30pm:
https://www.twitch.tv/assembleentertainment

Big shoutout to Marie (Sticky Business' Main Theme composer) - go check it out and meet Lofi Froggo!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hCtEyT02U9o

About Sticky Business
Who says that work can’t be fun? In Sticky Business, you have just launched your brand-new small business, where you’re able to use thousands of customization options to embrace your creativity and share your personal style with the world. Once your stickers are made, orders will start coming in and you'll have to pack them up and ship them off. Wait patiently as soon customers' kind words and even personal stories will come in as they share with you the impact your creations have had on their lives!
The more you create and deliver, the more stickers you’ll unlock and the more customers you will encounter as well. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43717490/abbc9a0f63de81e20af4ee9d481ae08037ef7b8f.png

Sticky Business also features a treat for Twitch streamers. The game features a special Twitch integration that allows viewers to place an order for the content creator to fulfill. It makes for a fun way to engage with your audience!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43717490/d432c5db190bec48f34640e461095dc5214ce3bb.png

Sticky Business' Features
 Create and Share: Get creative and build the cutest stickers out of thousands of possible combinations. Mix and match them to fit your personal style!
 Meet Your Customers: Businesses always start small and work their way up. Watch as your business grows and experience stories from the customers who place orders.
 Relax and Vibe: Enjoy a lovely pastel palette and a relaxing soundtrack to help inspire your perfect creations. 
 Earn and Upgrade: Use your hard-earned revenue to buy upgrades for your shop, get more sticker graphics and effect foils to make your products even more enticing.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43717490/ab0a5142248c646d68fdd010be31b02e404216ea.png

Everyone loves a good unboxing video, amirite? 
But it takes quite more from business owners to pack up those boxes so nicely. 

Today, we're delighted to reveal Sticky Business, our small business simulation game all about making stickers and creating memorable experiences for customers! You will create stickers with thousands of various customization options, pack orders, develop their online store, and build relationships with customers. 

Featured in Rokaplay’s “Cozy and Family Friendly Games Celebration”, Sticky Business is an authentic homage to the essence of a cozy game—unwind, reap rewards, and embrace a gentle journey free of penalties. 
Sticky Business joins today's Rokaplay showcase as a finalist among hundreds of game submissions and will exhibit as part of the Steam event alongside Assemble’s 2D adventure Fall of Porcupine. 

As if that wasn’t cozy enough, a limited-time free demo will be available as part of the Wholesome Direct showcase kicking off on June 10th!
store.steampowered.com/app/2303350/Sticky_Business/?utm_source=steamnews&utm_campaign=announcement

Watch the Sticky Business announcement trailer on YouTube:
[previewyoutube=HEgbHhKCSoc;full][/previewyoutube]


Coming to PC via Steam later this summer, Sticky Business relishes in the wholesome fun and simplicity of childlike creativity: creating stickers! With thousands of design options at your fingertips, the task may seem daunting at first, but the game’s approachable interface and charming visuals create a totally serene experience for the would-be small business owner. 

Of course, it can’t be all sticky, there’s also the tricky aspect of business management:
You must create an engaging, welcoming online storefront, allowing even more bursts of creativity and personal expression. From there, you can manage sales, pack orders, and even decide what sorts of goodies customers receive in their boxes. But even the tricky parts of business ownership prove rewarding, as what comes next is sitting back and watch the positive impact your stickers have on your customers’ lives.


What's in the box?
 Mix and match a plethora of the most wholesome and day-brightening stickers to create collections that are true to you — thousands of possible combinations available!
 Grow your business gradually, and expand your boxed orders to include sweet gifts
 A beautiful pastel palette will soothe your eyes just as the relaxing background tracks will soothe your ears
 Buy upgrades with your hard-earned revenue to get more sticker graphics and effect foils to make your shop even more tempting for customers

As a special bonus for content creators, we're pleased to announce a dedicated Twitch integration that will launch with Sticky Business. The integration will allow viewers in chat to put in “orders” for the streamer to pack in-game!

notes.title: Customize your Packages!
notes.content:
Make it pretty!

We really love to watch videos of small businesses pack their orders and we think one of the coolest things is to see how much love they pour into creating a nice packaging that fits the theme of their shop. In Sticky Business packing orders still looked a bit empty, especially if the order didn't include a whole lot of stickers. We wanted to make sure you can really customize your packages to give them your own style. Thats why we are currently working on decoration for the packages.

You will be able to unlock different parchment papers and fill it with squishy peanuts or crinkly paper to make sure your stickers travel save and comfy to their destination!
